gloss: to jump up; to spring up; to leap up

definitions.gloss: to jump up; to spring up; to leap into the air
definitions.explanation: To move upward suddenly by jumping, often from surprise, joy, or excitement.

examples.japanese: {嬉|うれ}しくて{飛|と}び{上|あ}がった。
{大|おお}きな{音|おと}に{驚|おどろ}いて{飛|と}び{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I jumped up, startled by the loud noise.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{飛|と}び{上|あ}がって{喜|よろこ}んだ。
examples.english: The children jumped up and down with delight.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Compound verb: {飛|と}ぶ + {上|あ}がる.

NUANCE: Often used to express emotional reactions like surprise or joy, rather than deliberate physical movement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{喜|よろこ}びで{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる: to jump for joy
・{驚|おどろ}いて{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる: to jump up in surprise
・{飛|と}び{上|あ}がって{喜|よろこ}ぶ: to be overjoyed (jumping with happiness)

IDIOMATIC:
・{飛|と}び{上|あ}がるほど{嬉|うれ}しい: so happy one could jump for joy
